title: India Plans ₹1 Lakh Crore Tender for 60 Transport Aircraft

blocks.content: India’s Ministry of Defence issued a Request for Proposal on 12 August 2026 for 60 multirole transport aircraft for the Indian Air Force , with an estimated value of about ₹1 lakh crore. The procurement plan places Indian companies in the lead role with foreign original equipment manufacturers for domestic production and Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul facilities.

items: The Antonov An-32 is a twin-turboprop military transport aircraft used by the Indian Air Force for tactical airlift roles.
Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul, or MRO, is a standard aviation term used for aircraft servicing and lifecycle support.
The C-130J Super Hercules is a military transport aircraft produced by Lockheed Martin and used by several air forces worldwide.
The C-390 Millennium is a jet-powered military transport aircraft developed by Embraer for tactical and strategic airlift missions.
